geosearch.title: Bangladesh Navy Headquarters Central Swimming Pool

7400870.title: Bangladesh Army Stadium
7400870.extract: The Bangladesh Army Stadium (formerly the Ershad Army Stadium) is a multi-purpose stadium in Dhaka, Bangladesh. It is currently used mostly for football matches, and hosts the home sport matches of the Bangladesh Army.

34053901.title: Airport Road, Dhaka
34053901.extract: Airport Road (Bengali: বিমানবন্দর সড়ক), also known as Tongi Division Road, a part of the Dhaka-Mymensingh Highway (N3), is an 8-lane major artery road in Dhaka, that connects Dhaka city, with the Shahjalal International Airport. It is also the main artery that connects Dhaka with the northern suburb of Uttara and the only road connection between Dhaka and northern Districts of Bangladesh.

38625895.title: Pioneer Dental College & Hospital
38625895.extract: Pioneer Dental College & Hospital is the first and the oldest private dental college and hospital in Bangladesh. It was founded in 1995 at Malibag area of Dhaka.

41185620.title: Infolink
41185620.extract: InfoLink Limited is a nationwide Bangladeshi Internet service provider (ISP), tracking service provider, call center, IPTV service provider and IT company working in the field of broadband internet, connectivity, software development, data center service and networking. It was the first company in Bangladesh to commercially deploy Bangladeshi-assembled kiosks, and it was the first company in Bangladesh to commercially deploy IPv6.

43572997.title: Armed Forces Medical Institute
43572997.extract: Armed Forces Medical Institute (AFMI) is the premier educational institute of the Army Medical Corps of Bangladesh Army. Immediately after liberation in 1971 to cope with the expansion of Armed Forces and to ensure efficient medical support at all levels, it was felt necessary to establish an institute for imparting training to Army Medical Corps (AMS), Army Dental Corps (ADC) and Armed Forces Nursing Services (AFNS) officers and other paramedics on various professional matters.

44424409.title: Kurmitola General Hospital
44424409.extract: Kurmitola General Hospital is a government hospital located in Kurmitola, Dhaka, Bangladesh.

50971554.title: July 2016 Dhaka attack
50971554.extract: The July 2016 Dhaka attack or Holey Artisan terrorist attack took place on the night of 1 July 2016, at 21:20 Bangladesh Standard Time (UTC+06:00), when five Islamic State (IS) terrorists took hostages and opened fire on the Holey Artisan Bakery in Gulshan Thana jurisdiction in Dhaka, Bangladesh. The terrorists entered the bakery with crude bombs, machetes, and pistols, and took several dozen hostages, including foreign nationals.

51572369.title: Shaheed Ramiz Uddin Cantonment College
51572369.extract:
Shaheed Ramiz Uddin Cantonment College
(Bengali: শহীদ রমিজ উদ্দিন ক্যান্টনমেন্ট কলেজ), also known as SRCC,  is an educational institution in Dhaka, Bangladesh, adjacent to Sursoptok underpass. It is managed by the Bangladesh Army, primarily for the children of army personnel, but students from civilian families can also study in this college.

51783667.title: Army Golf Club
51783667.extract: Army Golf Club is a golf club in Dhaka Cantonment, Bangladesh operated by Bangladesh Army. The present president of the club Lieutenant General Khan Firoz Ahmed.

53024796.title: Murder of Biswajit Das
53024796.extract: On 9 December 2012, Biswajit Das, a tailor from Dhaka, Bangladesh, was murdered by members of the Bangladesh Chhatra League (BCL), the student wing of the Awami League. That morning, the opposition 18 Party Alliance had called for a nationwide road blockade.

53396232.title: Baridhara Scholars Institution
53396232.extract: Baridhara Scholars' International School and College was established on 1 January 2001. It follows the Edexcel curriculum, and is located in Baridhara DOHS. The school is run by the Bangladesh Army.

55851987.title: Dhaka Cantonment railway station
55851987.extract: Dhaka Cantonment railway station is a railway station located in Dhaka, Bangladesh. It is notable as one of the termini of the Bangladesh-India Maitree Express & Mitali Express international passenger train service.

60464042.title: Continental Hospital PLC
60464042.extract: Continental Hospital PLC, formerly known as United Hospital Limited, is a private hospital in Gulshan-2, Dhaka, Bangladesh. Continental Hospital PLC, along with Evercare Hospital Dhaka and Square Hospital, are considered high-end private hospitals in Dhaka.

63986168.title: Gulshan Society Mosque
63986168.extract: The Gulshan Society Mosque, also called Gulshan Society Jame Masjid (Bengali: গুলশান সোসাইটি জামে মসজিদ), is a mosque in Gulshan, a neighbourhood in Dhaka. It was planned by Kashef Chowdhury and completed in 2017 for Gulshan Society.

69793064.title: Sursoptok underpass
69793064.extract: Sursoptok Underpass (Bengali: সুরসপ্তক আন্ডারপাস) is a pedestrian underpass located in  Dhaka, Bangladesh. It is one of four underpasses in Dhaka.

77637571.title: New Dhaka
77637571.extract: New Dhaka (Bengali: নতুন ঢাকা, romanized: Notun Dhaka or Bengali: নয়া ঢাকা, romanized: Noya Dhaka) is an unofficial term used to describe the area located north of Old Dhaka that has been incorporated in the city of Dhaka, the capital and largest city of Bangladesh over time. The term is ambiguous, as it may refer either to upscale and/or planned neighbourhoods with wider streets, modern buildings, and improved facilities, or to the city of Dhaka excluding the Old Dhaka region.

78059727.title: Bangladesh Navy Headquarters Central Swimming Pool
78059727.extract: Bangladesh Navy Headquarters Central Swimming Pool is a swimming sports competition hosting and training swimming pool operated by Bangladesh Navy. It is located inside the headquarters of the Bangladesh Navy in Banani, Dhaka.

82054282.title: High Commission of Pakistan, Dhaka
82054282.extract: The High Commission of Pakistan in Dhaka is the diplomatic mission of Pakistan to Bangladesh. This mission also handles diplomatic relations with Bhutan.

82939488.title: Feroza Bhaban
82939488.extract: The Feroza Bhaban (Bengali: ফিরোজা ভবন, romanized: phirōjā bhabana) was the private residence and a political office associated with Khaleda Zia, former Prime Minister of Bangladesh and chairperson of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). It is located at Gulshan, Dhaka, it has served as her principal residence since 2011 following her eviction from her previous residence on Shaheed Mainul Road in 2010.

82980317.title: 196, Gulshan Avenue
82980317.extract: The 196, Gulshan Avenue is the personal residence of Tarique Rahman, the Prime Minister of Bangladesh and chairman of Bangladesh Nationalist Party. It is located at Gulshan Avenue, Dhaka.

4980651.title: Dhaka Cantonment
4980651.extract: Dhaka Cantonment (Bengali: ঢাকা সেনানিবাস) is a cantonment located in the northern part of Dhaka, Bangladesh. The headquarters of the Bangladesh Army and Air Force are situated within the cantonment.

7407125.title: Baridhara
7407125.extract: Baridhara (Bengali: বারিধারা) is an upscale residential area in Dhaka, Bangladesh. It is located on the east of and northeast of Gulshan across Gulshan-Baridhara Lake.

9515767.title: Cantonment Thana
9515767.extract: Cantonment Thana (Bengali: ক্যান্টনমেন্ট) is a Thana of Dhaka district in Dhaka, Bangladesh. It includes the Army Headquarters, Naval Headquarters and the Air Force Headquarters.

9987324.title: American International School Dhaka
9987324.extract: The American International School Dhaka (AISD) is a not-for-profit, international, independent, and co-educational day school located in Baridhara, Dhaka, Bangladesh, serving students of all nationalities in pre-kindergarten through grade 12.

18557019.title: Armed Forces Medical College (Bangladesh)
18557019.extract: The Armed Forces Medical College (AFMC) is a public medical school located in Dhaka Cantonment, Dhaka, Bangladesh. Until 2008, it was affiliated with the University of Dhaka.

20034482.title: Jamuna Future Park
20034482.extract: Jamuna Future Park is a shopping mall in Dhaka, Bangladesh. It was inaugurated on 6 September 2013.

22014842.title: Mouchak Market
22014842.extract: Mouchak Market is one of the oldest and famous markets in Dhaka city. It was probably situated in the 1940s.

32861181.title: JAAGO Foundation
32861181.extract: JAAGO Foundation (Bengali: জাগো ফাউন্ডেশন) is a non-profit organisation based in Bangladesh providing education and social development opportunities to underprivileged children and communities. Established in April 2007 by Korvi Rakshand, the foundation has become a leading force in addressing issues related to education, poverty alleviation, and youth empowerment in the country.

38088941.title: Concord Group
38088941.extract: Concord Group is a Bangladeshi conglomerate that was founded in 1973. The industries under this conglomerate include construction, real estate, architecture & design, communication, entertainment, hospitality, and garments.

46827045.title: Bangladesh Open
46827045.extract: The Bangladesh Open is a golf tournament on the Asian Tour. The inaugural tournament was played from 27 to 30 May 2015 at Kurmitola Golf Club, in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

51279698.title: Sydney International School
51279698.extract: Sydney International School (SIS) is an international school located in Dhaka, Bangladesh, for 3-16 year old pupils. It was founded in 2012, and offers the Australian Curriculum for primary years and the Cambridge Curriculum for secondary years.

52915333.title: Holey Artisan Bakery
52915333.extract: Holey Artisan Bakery is a bakery headquartered in Bangladesh with most of its locations in Bangkok, Thailand. It was described in The New York Times "as among the most beloved restaurants in Dhaka".

53005606.title: Embassy of Japan, Dhaka
53005606.extract: The Embassy of Japan in Dhaka (Bengali: জাপানের দূতাবাস, ঢাকা) is the diplomatic mission of Japan in Bangladesh. Naoki Ito is the current ambassador of Japan in Bangladesh who was appointed on October in 2019.

53671114.title: Senakunja
53671114.extract: Senakunja is a convention centre of Bangladesh Armed Forces and is located in Dhaka Cantonment. The venue holds official events of Bangladesh Armed Forces.

53898476.title: Combined Military Hospital (Dhaka)
53898476.extract: Combined Military Hospital, Dhaka or CMH Dhaka is a military hospital located in Dhaka Cantonment. It is part of the Combined Military Hospital chain situated in all cantonments of Bangladesh.

57472068.title: Dhaka-17
57472068.extract: Dhaka-17 is a constituency represented in the Jatiya Sangsad (National Parliament) of Bangladesh since 2026 by Tarique Rahman of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party.

63261321.title: Banani graveyard
63261321.extract: The Banani graveyard (Bengali: বনানী কবরস্থান) is a cemetery in the Banani neighbourhood of Dhaka. It is one of eight state-run graveyards in Dhaka and, with a capacity for around 22,000 graves, one of the largest graveyards in that city.

71288673.title: Blockbuster Cinemas
71288673.extract: The Blockbuster Cinemas is a cineplex located in Dhaka, Bangladesh. It was opened on September 6, 2013.

75300769.title: Justice Shahabuddin Ahmed Park
75300769.extract: Justice Shahabuddin Ahmed Park (Bengali: বিচারপতি শাহাবুদ্দিন আহমেদ পার্ক) or in short Shahabuddin Park, is an urban park located in the Gulshan 2 area of Dhaka, Bangladesh. In 2008 the lake was named Shahabuddin Ahmed lake, around which the park was founded in 2020 on a 9.45 acres (3.82 ha) of land.

75860780.title: Embassy of North Korea, Dhaka
75860780.extract: The Embassy of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea in Dhaka (Korean: 주 방글라데시 조선민주주의인민공화국 대사관; MR: Chu Panggŭlladeshi Chosŏn Minjujuŭi Inmin Konghwaguk Daesagwan) was the diplomatic mission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to the People's Republic of Bangladesh, located in Dhaka. It was opened in 1974, a year after North Korea established diplomatic ties with Bangladesh.

1637417.title: North South University
1637417.extract: North South University (Bengali: নর্থ সাউথ বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়, also known as NSU) is a private research university in Dhaka, Bangladesh. It was established in 1992.

7940890.title: Radio Foorti
7940890.extract: Radio Foorti is first Bangladeshi FM radio station. The station went live on 22 September 2006, and is currently available in Dhaka, Chittagong, Sylhet.

37965021.title: Doreen Tower
37965021.extract: Doreen Tower is a high-rise skyscraper centered in the Gulshan-2 circle of Dhaka. The 25-story building has a height of 112 meters (367 feet), and is the 11th tallest building in Bangladesh.

63906991.title: Banani Bidyaniketan School and College
63906991.extract: Banani Bidyaniketan School and College is an educational institution in Banani, Dhaka, Bangladesh.

66066228.title: Kuril Flyover
66066228.extract: The Kuril Flyover is the third largest flyover in Bangladesh. It is located in Dhaka.

69971298.title: Madani Avenue
69971298.extract: Madani Avenue is an urban road situated in Dhaka, the capital of Bangladesh. The street is named after G.A. Madani, who was chairman of Dhaka Improvement Trust in East Pakistan (currently RAJUK).

74693013.title: Embassy of Argentina, Dhaka
74693013.extract: The Embassy of Argentina in Dhaka is the diplomatic mission of the Argentine Republic to the People's Republic of Bangladesh. It is located in the Banani neighborhood of Dhaka.

75400014.title: Embassy of Sweden, Dhaka
75400014.extract: The Embassy of Sweden in Dhaka is Sweden's diplomatic mission in Bangladesh. It is located in the Gulshan area of the capital.

78051636.title: Bhashantek Thana
78051636.extract: Bhashantek Thana (Bengali: ভাষানটেক থানা) is a police jurisdiction of Dhaka North City Corporation under Dhaka District in Bangladesh. This police station is an integral part of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police network, contributing to the safety and security of the Bhashantek area.

79566291.title: Nirjhor Residential Area
79566291.extract: Nirjhor Residential Area (Bengali: নির্ঝর আবাসিক এলাকা) is a residential area in Dhaka Cantonment, Bangladesh.
